topic: CI build resource issues and maintenance
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the instability of a Continuous Integration (CI) build process, which was observed to fail after attempts were made to reduce JavaScript compilation levels from ES6 to ES5. The issue was attributed to insufficient resources allocated in CircleCI (CC). It was suggested that the automatic build for mops should be disabled to conserve credits and effort.

Regarding resource allocation, there was a discussion about needing more powerful Docker resources than the current 4GB RAM limit provides for successful builds. Ultimately, payment was made to ensure the CI process could proceed, allowing the Node.js build to complete successfully.
decisions: Disable automatic mops builds to conserve credits
Payment was made to resolve CI resource limitations
